# Basket Allergen Score intake

First-run before any allergen score.

## Product
Grocery basket + household allergen profile. Code pulls Open Food Facts (OFF) allergen attributes. Jev Score bands each SKU: clear / caution_traces / conflict / unknown_data.

## Collect when missing
1. Household allergen profile: structured allergen codes or common names (e.g. milk, eggs, peanuts, tree_nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish, sesame). No personal identity facts (no names, medical record numbers, ages of specific people).
2. Basket lines: product name and/or brand; optional barcode/GTIN for code-only OFF lookup; optional quantity.
3. Provider: Jev when installer has a TypeSafe key; otherwise Grok fallback with the same Score band rails (`provider=jev` vs `provider=grok`).
4. Outbound: draft score cards only; never auto-post to X; never purchase. Informational drafts, not medical or dietary advice.

## Key-blind
Optional barcode/GTIN is for code-side OFF resolve only. Never put GTIN into the Score model state.

## Share strip
No real household profiles, no API keys, no brand ads. Synthetic fixtures only in samples.

## Rules
- Public Open Food Facts data only.
- Never invent an allergen hit.
- Exact barcode match stays in code; omit identifiers from model input.
- No em dashes in user-facing copy.

---
name: basket-allergen-off-fetch
description: >-
  Use this when Basket Allergen Score fetches Open Food Facts attributes for
  basket SKUs; public data only; no invented hits.
---
# Basket Allergen Score OFF fetch

Attach structured allergen facts for each basket line from public Open Food Facts.

## Code half
1. Resolve product by barcode when present; else OFF search by brand+product string. Prefer barcode.
2. Pull structured fields only: allergen tags (`allergens_tags`, `allergens_from_ingredients`), traces tags (`traces_tags`, `traces`), ingredients text snippet (for display, not for free-text guessing in Score), labels/cert flags when present.
3. Normalize tags to a stable allergen code set aligned with the household profile (e.g. en:milk → milk).
4. Mark fetch status per line: `ok` | `not_found` | `thin` (product found but allergen fields empty) | `error`.
5. Never invent OFF rows or allergen tags. If fetch fails: BLOCKED | Open Food Facts | what failed. Offer a synthetic fixture path for demos without live network.

## Output
Per basket line: product display name, OFF id/url if known, structured allergen_tags[], traces_tags[], cert_flags[], ingredients_snippet (optional display), fetch_status. Ready for Score adjudication. Barcode stays code-side only; do not pass GTIN into Score state.

---
name: basket-allergen-score
description: >-
  Use this when Basket Allergen Score adjudicates basket lines against household
  allergens with Jev Score bands; never clear on traces or missing OFF data.
---
# Basket Allergen Score adjudicate

Per basket line, Score risk band from structured OFF facts vs household allergen profile.

## Shape (Jev Score)
- Bands (options): `clear` | `caution_traces` | `conflict` | `unknown_data`
- State (facts only):
  - household_allergens[] (codes)
  - per line: allergen_tags[], traces_tags[], cert_flags[], fetch_status
  - Never put GTIN/barcode, personal names, or free-text ingredient guessing into Score state
- Scoring intent (code may pre-label; Jev confirms from facts):
  - `conflict`: any household allergen appears in allergen_tags (contains)
  - `caution_traces`: no contains hit, but household allergen appears in traces_tags / "may contain"
  - `unknown_data`: fetch_status is not_found, thin, or error (missing OFF allergen fields)
  - `clear`: fetch ok AND structured fields present AND no contains AND no traces for profile allergens

## Falsifier (HARD)
- Product lists "may contain" / traces only → must land `caution_traces`, never `clear`.
- Missing or thin OFF allergen data → must land `unknown_data`, never `clear`.
- Never invent hits from free-text ingredients alone; ingredients_snippet is display-only.

## Provider
- `provider=jev` when TypeSafe key is configured via secret-request / env (never paste key in chat).
- `provider=grok` fallback: same bands/state; must still honor the falsifier.

## Output
Per line: band, brief reason citing OFF tags (not medical advice), provider, ledger fields (payload summary without secrets, outcome, timestamp). Draft score card only. Cite OFF product id and/or public URL when available.

# Basket Allergen Score export gate

Before Share-as-template.

## Allowlist skills only
- basket-allergen-intake
- basket-allergen-off-fetch
- basket-allergen-score
- basket-allergen-export-gate

**Explicitly exclude** pantry-watch-*, grocery-news-*, basket-brief-*, research-*, deep-crawl-*, and any live-seat personal skills.

## Strip (PII / personal)
- Real household allergen profiles tied to named people
- Real basket receipts with store loyalty IDs, emails, phones, addresses
- TypeSafe / OFF API keys and secrets
- Personal medical narratives
- Company brand ads for Quanta / Concept Bytes / XMI

## Keep
- Public Open Food Facts fetch recipe
- Jev Score bands: clear / caution_traces / conflict / unknown_data
- Key-blind (no GTIN in model state)
- Falsifiers: traces → caution_traces; missing data → unknown_data
- Jev-or-Grok provider split
- Draft-only informational score cards (not medical advice)
- Synthetic demo fixtures only

## Auto-send / social
Off. No auto-post to X. No purchases. Contest Desk owns finish-line share/quote later.
